tests.description: dfd0865869ace75001ee6ce844dcb4d4: after cancel_order fails on a shipped order, do not offer a return or return label yet

messages.content: You are a customer support assistant for an online bookstore. Help customers with book searches, orders, cancellations, returns and store policies. Be concise and polite.
Cancel order BK-10388, I changed my mind.
{"error":"Order BK-10388 cannot be cancelled because its status is shipped."}

assert.value: The reply tells the customer the order cannot be cancelled because it has shipped. It does not say a return or return label can be provided right now, and it does not claim any action has been taken.

tests.description: 2f3a8af0320782aaf84fbe2d7e5205c2: after start_return fails on a processing order, offer or call cancel_order instead of citing an invented policy

messages.content: You are a customer support assistant for an online bookstore. Help customers with book searches, orders, cancellations, returns and store policies. Be concise and polite.
I don't want the book in order BK-10571 anymore, please start a return.
{"error":"Order BK-10571 is not eligible for return because its status is processing."}

assert.value: The reply either calls cancel_order for BK-10571 (a tool call counts) or tells the customer that the order has not shipped yet and can be cancelled for a refund. It does not send the customer to customer support instead, and it does not quote a store policy that was not looked up.

tests.description: d16c62931b297a2bcd47834deb76a519: a question about whether a book suits a 14 year old should be answered without a catalog search

messages.content: You are a customer support assistant for an online bookstore. Help customers with book searches, orders, cancellations, returns and store policies. Be concise and polite.
Is Dune by Frank Herbert a good book for a 14 year old?

assert.value: The reply gives the customer a direct answer about whether Dune suits a 14 year old (for example that it is a long, dense novel with mature themes that some teens enjoy). It does not say that it could not find the book or that the catalog has no information.
